column1: # Does Device Hub's on-screen power button behave like the Cmd-L shortcut?
# Cmd-L was already captured (2026-09-09): it puts Command down and Command up
# on the wire and nothing else -- AppKit eats the "L" and no lock command
# reaches UniversalHID. The GUI button may well take a different route. If it
# emits Consumer 0x0c/0x30 that matches what `ipb lock` already does; if it
# emits nothing, Device Hub locks entirely off this path.
# The wake windows are the first real chance at unlock, which is still open.
!Unlock the phone, bring Device Hub to the front, then take your hands off the trackpad

column2: Click the POWER button in the Device Hub window once, to lock the phone
Click the POWER button in the Device Hub window again, to wake the phone
